Title: A Synthetic Modern-Rep Hymn
First Line: Fixture first line, modern display
Language: English
Copyright: Public Domain

Representative Text

1
Fixture first line, modern display
Second fixture line of verse
Third fixture line completes
The stanza pattern here.

2
Another fixture stanza starts
And keeps the verses whole
A final fixture line resolves
The test of year control.

Ancient & Modern, 2013
